title: Elementary Handbook of the Shan Language
author: Rev. J. N. Cushing
genre: Pedagogical Grammar & Conversational Manual of Southwestern Tai
description: Comprehensive practical handbook published by the American Baptist Mission Press, Rangoon, featuring systematic grammatical explanations, phrase structures, numeral classifiers, and authentic everyday dialogues in Southwestern Tai (Shan / Tai Khamyang sister variety).
